Monthly Magic is not just a tea subscription, it is an ongoing ceremonial journey.

In 2026, we enter She Rises. A sacred exploration of the Divine Feminine through the archetypes of the goddesses. Each month reveals a new goddess, a new embodiment, a new way of rising.

Rooted in ancient wisdom and guided by Master Blender Zhena Muzyka, every box is crafted with astrological timing, rare botanicals, and over 25 years of herbal expertise.

Each Monthly Shipment Includes: 

A Limited Edition Goddess Tea

An exclusive, small batch wellness blend inspired by that month’s goddess archetype. Crafted with rare botanicals and aligned to seasonal and cosmic rhythms. Available only to subscribers.

A Printed Ritual Guide

Seasonal teachings, goddess wisdom, journaling prompts, and step by step ceremony instructions to bring the archetype into your daily life.

Live Magic Monday Teaching

A monthly live gathering with Zhena where we steep the tea together, explore the goddess of the month, and align as a global circle. Replay included.

Community and Cosmic Alignment

Astrological insight, seasonal rhythm guidance, and practices to help you embody the Divine Feminine in grounded, practical ways.

Special Ritual Gift 

Gifts can range from ritual oils, skin sprays, books, bath soaks, apothecary items, etc. 

ANNUAL MEMBERS RECEIVE A COMPLIMENTARY GIFT

When you commit to the annual Monthly Magic journey, your first box arrives with a complimentary Lose Leaf Starter Kit

  • Gold tea strainer
  • Ceremonial scoop
  • Tea timer
  • Moon ritual card

A complete beginning, so your ritual is fully formed from the very first sip.

THE 2026 THEME: She Rises

This year we walk with the Greek goddesses.

Each month invites you to embody a new facet of feminine power. Beauty. Wisdom. Sovereignty. Instinct. Creation.

WHO THIS IS FOR

Women who crave ritual. Women who want deeper hormonal and nervous system support through botanical allies. Women who feel called to live in rhythm rather than rush. Women ready to rise.

Monthly Magic is a living ceremony. A global circle. A steady rhythm you can trust.

If it feels true in your body, this is your year to steep in the wisdom of the goddesses and rise, month by month.
